props.covers: Sections are the grouping and addressability mechanism: every idea has a section, content keeps clear air from its frame, and a finished section closes around its children when explicitly fitted.

text.insert: A section is the only container and the board's addressable grouping unit. Give every piece of content a home and keep air between children and the frame. A frame holds the space it is given; close it around its children with an explicit fit when the region is finished.

makes sections the grouping signal and requires air at every border. Section capabilities define geometric membership and nested containment. Membership is reconciled from geometry after every operation. A section closes around its children only when
names it. That call fits only the named section, never its ancestors. The
lint blocks children outside their section and content outside the locked page frame, and its suggestion points to the fit operation.

Workflow: create the complete section skeleton before placing content. Fill one section at a time in reading order and judge its render before moving to the next; children move, and the frame closes around them when you fit it.
